roadmap.title: Clear the profile and mode tasks
roadmap.description: Build the main-menu background, publish a Workshop creation, and complete the first six Challenge Mode trials before continuing toward all 50.

roadmap.title: Establish the Survival route
roadmap.description: Complete Your First Car, collect Hubert's mustache, begin farming and raids, rescue caged farmers, and accumulate early bot and crafting counters.

roadmap.title: Advance through Growlabs and Scrap City
roadmap.description: Complete the first Growlab, rescue the Baby Woc, reach the Garage, clear the Hay Maze, and finish the food and explosive setup achievements.

roadmap.title: Finish underground progression and collections
roadmap.description: Activate the Mining Hub, defeat Minerbots, survive the Seekerbot, raise the Vault, complete request chains, and finish all schematics and outfits.

roadmap.title: Complete the remaining grinds
roadmap.description: Finish 50 raids, win a level 5 defense, reach the high-speed threshold, close every cumulative counter, and trigger the all-achievements check.

achievements.summary: Defeat one @enemy{Farmbot}; spawning and destroying one in Creative Mode also registers the achievement.

guide.context: Creative Mode is the quickest controlled route because it removes the Survival preparation needed for a Farmbot encounter.

steps.text: Open a Creative Mode world and place a @enemy{Farmbot} from the inventory.
Use a weapon or armed creation to destroy the spawned @enemy{Farmbot} completely.

achievements.summary: Complete all 50 @mechanic{Master Mechanic Trials} in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: The trials are selected from the main menu, and patch 1.0.2 restored items that were missing from some challenge chests.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Challenge Mode} from the main menu and open the Master Mechanic Trials set.
Complete Trials 1 through 50, satisfying each level's finish condition before advancing.
Return to the trial selection screen and confirm that all 50 trials show as completed.

achievements.summary: Complete the first six @mechanic{Master Mechanic Trials} in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: These are the opening levels of the same 50-trial set required for the later full Challenge Mode achievement.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Challenge Mode} from the main menu and start the Master Mechanic Trials.
Complete Trials 1 through 6 in order and return to the selection screen after Trial 6 registers.

achievements.description: Complete the builder quest: Your first car
achievements.summary: Complete the Builder request @mechanic{Your First Car} by assembling its vehicle on the marked construction platform.

guide.context: The request becomes available immediately after its introductory cutscene and uses the orange platform control to start construction.

steps.text: After the Builder cutscene, press the orange button beside the marked construction platform.
Place the @item{Lift} on the platform and build the requested car to the displayed specification.
Complete every shown vehicle requirement and wait for the Builder request to close.

achievements.summary: Complete every construction request offered by the Builder NPCs encountered across the Survival world.

guide.context: Complete the opening @mechanic{Your First Car} request before continuing with the construction-platform requests encountered later in Survival.

steps.text: Accept each Builder construction request encountered during Survival exploration.
At the request's construction site, build the vehicle or structure specified by its displayed objectives.
Continue accepting and completing Builder construction requests until the Steam achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Use @npc{Hubert}'s Growlab key, clear the first @loc{Growlab}, and reach the final chamber where the central sphere bursts.

guide.context: Hubert's quest chain supplies the key and map marker. Patch 1.0.4 redesigned a later Growlab combat corridor to prevent a progression lockout.

steps.text: Complete @npc{Hubert}'s active quests until he gives you the first @item{Growlab key} and marks the facility.
Travel to the marked @loc{Growlab}, insert the key at the entrance, and call the elevator.
Follow the laboratory objectives through every required room until the central sphere bursts in the final chamber.
Collect the completion reward and Large Chest schematic after the first Growlab closes.

achievements.summary: Complete every Farmer delivery request encountered during Survival progression.

guide.context: Farmer delivery requests are separate from both Builder construction requests and the cumulative Caged Farmer rescues.

steps.text: Accept each Farmer delivery request encountered during Survival progression.
Bring the exact items and quantities shown by the active delivery objective to its named destination.
Continue accepting and completing Farmer delivery requests until the Steam achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Reach the campaign encounter with the @npc{Baby Woc}, defeat the attacking bots, and take the rescued Baby Woc with you.

guide.context: The Baby Woc appears through normal campaign progression and becomes a persistent companion after the rescue encounter.

steps.text: Continue the Survival campaign until the @npc{Baby Woc} is found under attack by bots.
Destroy every bot threatening the @npc{Baby Woc}.
Approach and collect the safe @npc{Baby Woc}, then wait for the rescue objective to complete.

achievements.summary: Grow and harvest 500 seed-planted crops from soil in Survival Mode.

guide.context: Every crop type grown from seed contributes, so normal food farming and Farmer deliveries can advance this counter together.

steps.text: Place soil, plant any crop seeds, and water the plots until the crops mature.
Collect each mature crop directly from its plant.
Replant and harvest until 500 crops have been collected across the save.

achievements.description: Save 10 caged farmers by bringing them to the Hideout
achievements.summary: Transport 10 @npc{Caged Farmers} to the delivery point at the @loc{Hideout}.

guide.context: This is a cumulative Survival counter, so each rescued cage can be delivered whenever the route passes the Hideout.

steps.text: Find a @npc{Caged Farmer} in the Survival world and secure the cage to a transport creation.
Drive the cage to the @loc{Hideout} used for Farmer deliveries.
Place the @npc{Caged Farmer} in the Hideout's delivery point and wait for the delivery to register.
Repeat the transport route until 10 separate caged farmers have registered.

achievements.summary: Raise the @mechanic{Vault Value} display to 2,000,000.

guide.context: Patch 1.0.3 fixed cases where the Vault quota completed before its introduction quest advanced, so install the current patch before building this counter.

steps.text: Progress until the Vault introduction is active and identify the displayed @mechanic{Vault Value}.
Increase the displayed @mechanic{Vault Value} until it reaches 2,000,000 and the Steam achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Destroy 100 @enemy{Haybots}; kills in Creative Mode count toward the total.

guide.context: Creative Mode can provide repeatable spawns, while a Survival run naturally supplies many Haybots during raids and exploration.

steps.text: Use normal Survival encounters or spawn @enemy{Haybots} in a Creative Mode world.
Destroy Haybots completely until 100 kills have registered.

achievements.summary: Destroy 100 @enemy{Totebots}; kills in Creative Mode count toward the total.

guide.context: Totebots are common early enemies, so this counter can be advanced naturally before using Creative Mode for any remainder.

steps.text: Fight Totebots during Survival progression or spawn them in a Creative Mode world.
Destroy Totebots completely until 100 kills have registered.

achievements.summary: Destroy 100 @enemy{Minerbots} in the underground or through controlled Creative Mode spawns.

guide.context: Minerbots belong to the 1.0 underground progression, making this the latest of the three 100-bot counters during a normal Survival route.

steps.text: Unlock the underground through the Survival questline or open a Creative Mode world with Minerbots available.
Destroy Minerbots completely until 100 kills have registered.

achievements.summary: Trigger and successfully defend 50 crop raids by keeping the protected crops intact until every attacking bot is defeated.

guide.context: Cotton and Pigment Flowers have no raid value, so plant food crops when intentionally building this cumulative counter.

steps.text: Plant and water food crops until the raid indicator confirms an incoming attack.
Return before the raid starts and destroy every attacking bot before the protected crops are lost.
Harvest and replant between attacks until 50 successful raid defenses have registered.

achievements.summary: Craft 10,000 blocks of any type; Craftbot production in Creative Mode also counts.

guide.context: Because the requirement counts crafted blocks rather than placed blocks, large queued Craftbot batches are more efficient than constructing a large creation.

steps.text: Place and open a @item{Craftbot} in Survival or Creative Mode.
Queue inexpensive block recipes in the largest practical batches and collect each completed stack.
Continue Craftbot production until 10,000 crafted blocks have registered.

achievements.description: Successfully defend crops against a level 5 raid
achievements.summary: Generate at least 1,000 crop value and defeat the resulting level 5 raid without losing the defended farm.

guide.context: In the 1.0 raid table, Pineapple is worth 1,000 crop value by itself; level 5 introduces Farmbots and Blue Tapebots.

steps.text: Build durable farm walls, ranged firing positions, and repair access before planting the qualifying crops.
Plant crops totaling at least 1,000 raid value, such as one Pineapple, and wait for the raid indicator to show level 5.
Be present when the raid begins and destroy the complete level 5 wave before it destroys the farm.

achievements.description: Reach a very high speed while sitting in a seat
achievements.summary: While seated in a creation, exceed the game's undisclosed very-high-speed threshold.

guide.context: The trigger can fail even at very high seated speed, so repeat the run if the first attempt does not register.

steps.text: Sit in a seat attached to a creation capable of reaching very high speed.
Accelerate the seated creation to its highest speed and maintain that speed until the achievement registers.

achievements.summary: Let a @enemy{Seekerbot} detect and attack you, then remain alive until its attack ends or you escape detection.

guide.context: The Seekerbot can appear every one to three in-game days and launches many tracking rockets; bridges and enclosed structures provide safer cover than an open chase.

steps.text: Watch for the large scanning @enemy{Seekerbot} during Survival exploration and approach until it detects you.
Move under a bridge or inside a solid structure before the tracking rockets arrive.
Remain alive through the attack and stay in cover or escape until the encounter ends.

achievements.summary: Fill a @item{Bucket} with water and throw the water onto a @enemy{Haybot} to short it out.

guide.context: The water hit disables the Haybot temporarily and can be performed in Creative Mode for a controlled setup.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Bucket} and fill it from a water source.
Face a nearby @enemy{Haybot} and throw the bucket's water directly onto the bot.
Wait for the Haybot's electrical shutdown reaction to register.

achievements.description: Build a creation in the Garage.
achievements.summary: At the @loc{Scrap City Garage}, import an exported Creative Mode blueprint and have the Garage assemble it; a one-block blueprint is sufficient.

guide.context: The @loc{Scrap City Garage} becomes accessible late in Survival progression.

steps.text: In Creative Mode, place one block on a Lift and use the blueprint export tool to export that creation.
Follow the Survival story until the late-game @loc{Scrap City Garage} becomes accessible, then enter the Garage building.
Climb the side stairs, use the Garage terminal, choose @mechanic{Import Blueprint}, and select the exported Creative Mode file.
Supply any requested materials and confirm assembly, then wait for the Garage to produce the creation.

achievements.description: Destroy two blue tapebots with a cornade
achievements.summary: Destroy two @enemy{Blue Tapebots} with the same @item{Cornade} explosion.

guide.context: Creative Mode allows both targets and the Cornade to be staged together without waiting for a Survival encounter.

steps.text: Place two @enemy{Blue Tapebots} close enough together for one explosion to hit both; Creative Mode is the simplest setup.
Throw one @item{Cornade} between the two Blue Tapebots.
Ensure that the single Cornade blast destroys both Blue Tapebots.

achievements.description: Use an explosive canister to blow up a Woc
achievements.summary: Kill one @npc{Woc} by detonating an @item{Explosive Canister} beside it.

guide.context: The target and canister can be staged in Creative Mode, avoiding the cost of crafting the explosive in Survival.

steps.text: Place an @npc{Woc} and an @item{Explosive Canister} next to each other in Creative Mode or Survival.
Damage the Explosive Canister from a safe distance to detonate it.
Ensure that the canister explosion kills the Woc.

achievements.summary: Unlock every character outfit through @item{Garment Boxes}, quest rewards, and the 50 Master Mechanic Trials.

guide.context: A Dressbot opens common Garment Boxes for 10 Cotton and rare Garment Boxes for 15 Cotton, while the Stuntman set comes from completing all trials.

steps.text: Open each common @item{Garment Box} in a @item{Dressbot} with 10 Cotton and each rare Garment Box with 15 Cotton.
Complete quests that award clothing and claim each outfit reward they provide.
Complete all 50 Master Mechanic Trials to unlock the Stuntman outfit.
Open the Dressbot Wardrobe and continue earning missing rewards until every outfit entry is unlocked.

achievements.description: Build something in the main menu
achievements.summary: Open the main-menu background editor, build any object, and save the edited background when leaving.

guide.context: The editor is opened with the blue button at the bottom of the main menu and accepts even a minimal creation.

steps.text: Press the blue edit button at the bottom of the main menu.
Place at least one block or part in the background scene.
Exit the editor and choose to save the modified main-menu background.

achievements.description: Share a creation on the Steam Workshop
achievements.summary: Save a named Creative Mode creation and publish it with the @mechanic{Share} command to the Steam Workshop.

guide.context: The Share command is used from a saved Creative Mode blueprint created on a Lift; saving the blueprint locally is only the preparation step.

steps.text: In Creative Mode, place a Lift and build any creation on it.
Use the Lift menu to save the creation and give it a name.
Open the saved blueprint entry, choose @mechanic{Share}, complete the Steam Workshop upload fields, and publish it.

achievements.description: Wear the Pizza Burger shirt while eating a Pizza Burger
achievements.summary: Wear the @item{Pizza Burger Shirt}, then consume a @item{Pizza Burger} cooked from 1 Woc meat, 5 Tomatoes, and 10 Potatoes.

guide.context: Patch 1.0.1 fixed this achievement's launch bug, so update the game before attempting the shirt-and-food check.

steps.text: Use a @item{Cookbot} to craft a Pizza Burger with 1 Woc meat, 5 Tomatoes, and 10 Potatoes.
Open Garment Boxes with a @item{Dressbot} until the @item{Pizza Burger Shirt} is unlocked.
Open character customization and equip the @item{Pizza Burger Shirt}.
While the Pizza Burger Shirt is still equipped, consume the cooked @item{Pizza Burger}.

achievements.description: Activate all stations in the Mining Hub
achievements.summary: Activate every station in the @loc{Mining Hub}.

guide.context: This objective belongs to the underground progression and cannot be completed before the Mining Hub becomes accessible.

steps.text: Progress through the underground story until the @loc{Mining Hub} becomes accessible.
Activate each station available inside the Mining Hub.
Continue activating stations until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Destroy a bot with a creation
achievements.summary: Kill any bot by striking it with a player-built powered creation.

guide.context: A gasoline-engine vehicle has enough impact force for a simple run-over and is easier to control than an explosive contraption.

steps.text: Build a drivable creation with a seat, wheels, and a gasoline engine.
Line up a Totebot or Haybot on a clear stretch of ground.
Accelerate the creation into the bot and continue striking it with the vehicle until the bot is destroyed.

achievements.summary: Unlock each of Scrap Mechanic's other 33 Steam achievements on the same Steam account.

guide.context: This meta-achievement is the final completion check and should be left until every mode, Survival counter, collection, and online Workshop task is finished.

steps.text: Open Scrap Mechanic's Steam achievement list and identify any locked entry other than Spectacular Mechanic.
Complete every remaining locked requirement until the other 33 achievements are unlocked.
Return to the game and allow the achievement system to register the completed roster.

achievements.description: Reach the Center of the Hay Maze
achievements.summary: Enter the @loc{Hay Maze} near Growlab 2, navigate to its central area, and break open the schematic capsule.

guide.context: The maze contains roughly five or six Farmbots; a bridge built from about 500 blocks can reach the center from above with less direct combat.

steps.text: Bring roughly 500 building blocks to the @loc{Hay Maze} near Growlab 2.
Climb onto a tall hay stack at the maze edge and begin a bridge toward the center.
Extend the bridge above the maze toward the central schematic capsule while staying out of reach of the Farmbots.
Reach the center and strike the schematic capsule to open it.

achievements.summary: Pick up @npc{Hubert}'s missing mustache piece from the corner of his build platform opposite the kiosk.

guide.context: The piece is available around the first meeting with Hubert, so it can be collected near the beginning instead of waiting for later story progress.

steps.text: Travel to @npc{Hubert}'s build platform during the early Survival questline.
Walk to the platform corner on the side opposite Hubert's kiosk.
Pick up the loose mustache piece lying on that corner of the platform.

achievements.description: Get revived by the Baby Woc
achievements.summary: After rescuing the @npc{Baby Woc}, keep it nearby and let your mechanic be knocked out so the Baby Woc revives you.

guide.context: The rescued companion must remain present; keep the Baby Woc fed because it can despawn after roughly 30 in-game days without food.

steps.text: Complete the campaign rescue encounter and keep the rescued @npc{Baby Woc} nearby.
Keep the @npc{Baby Woc} beside you and allow an enemy or hazard to reduce your mechanic's health to zero.
Do not respawn manually; wait for the nearby @npc{Baby Woc} to perform the revival.

achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Schematicbots} to unlock every block schematic from Schematic Boxes and eligible owned blocks.

guide.context: A Schematic Box removes one random eligible unlock from the remaining pool, while presenting an eligible block you already own targets that exact part.

steps.text: Locate a @mechanic{Schematicbot} beside a road or at the guaranteed underground location.
Collect Schematic Boxes from loot and submit them to the Schematicbot for random missing block unlocks.
When you possess a still-locked eligible block, present that block to the Schematicbot to unlock its exact schematic.
Continue both scan routes until the Schematicbot has no locked block schematic remaining.
